newsitem.title: USA: Perot jeered by Christian Coalition.
newsitem.headline: Perot jeered by Christian Coalition.

text.p: Texas billionaire Ross Peerot was booed on Friday at a conference of the Christian Coalition when he asserted that his 1992 presidential bid did not help U.S. President Bill Clinton get elected.
"That's why I brought it up. No smooth politicians would have given you that opportunity, right?," Perot said, smiling uneasily, as the audience continued jeering.
"I ask you, as honest Christian people, to please go to the library and study the exit polls from the 1992 election. You will find I drew equally from both candidates," he said.
Perot won 19 percent of the vote in 1992 but is trailing with around five percent in the polls this year.
He was widely blamed by Republicans for dividing the conservative vote and allowing Clinton to be elected with only 43 percent of the vote.
The Christian Coalition is a powerful lobby within the Republican Party and lobbies against abortion and in favour of prayer in school and other traditional values.
